men.summary: The Bluejays are 2-0 after home wins over Kansas City (76-61) and Le Moyne (83-55), though the early NET ranking of 83 and RPI of 27 reflect a very small sample and no Quadrant 1 games yet. Big East play hasn't started, so the postseason outlook is still open, and the résumé will depend on how they handle upcoming marquee non-conference matchups and conference opportunities.

women.summary: The Bluejays are 1-0 after a 73-71 road win at South Dakota State on Nov 2, a Quadrant 1 victory that has pushed their RPI to 2 even though their NET ranking sits at 91. With Big East play still to start (0-0) and just one game played, the postseason outlook is wide open, and the NET ranking suggests they will need a strong conference record to build an NCAA Tournament case rather than relying on the early RPI.
